issues.description: Condition could be expressed more clearly with a helper or comment
issues.detail: The expression `!(nodeName === 'layer' && typeof node.nodes === 'undefined')` is correct but reads awkwardly inside an already-complex boolean. A small comment explaining that statement-form `@layer foo;` is allowed before `@import` while block-form `@layer foo {}` is not would help future readers.

issues.description: Missing accept-case test for statement-form @layer before @import
issues.detail: The fix preserves the existing allowance for `@layer foo;` (no block) before `@import`, but only a reject case for the block form is added. An explicit accept test like `@layer foo; @import url('x.css');` would lock in that the narrowing did not regress the documented allowance.

issues.description: No test for anonymous layer block `@layer {}` before import
issues.detail: The new check uses `typeof node.nodes === 'undefined'` to detect block form, which also catches anonymous `@layer {}`. Worth adding a reject test for `@layer {}\n@import ...` to document that anonymous block layers also invalidate a following `@import`, matching the CSS spec.

review.summary: The change is a tight, well-scoped bug fix: it narrows the `@layer` exemption so that only statement-form `@layer foo;` (no block) is allowed before `@import`, while block-form `@layer foo {}` correctly triggers the rule. The logic via `typeof node.nodes === 'undefined'` is consistent with how PostCSS distinguishes at-rule statements from containers. A changeset and one reject test are included. Minor polish suggestions only: a clarifying comment, an explicit accept test for statement-form layers, and a test for anonymous `@layer {}`.
